errors.title_not_found_add: {name} couldn't find this title, so it can't be added.
errors.bad_type: type must be movie or series
errors.bad_log_level: level must be a log level such as WARNING or ERROR
errors.internal: Something went wrong in the gateway (request {request_id}). The gateway log has the details: Settings → Troubleshooting → Download debug report.
errors.data_not_writable: The data folder {path} is not writable by uid {uid}. Fix it on the host with: sudo chown -R {uid}:{gid} <the folder mounted at {path}>, or set PUID/PGID to the folder's owner. ({error})
errors.config_path_outside: Config error in {file}: {setting} is "{value}", which is not inside the {folder} folder. Use a relative path with no "..", e.g. "name.ext".
errors.config_folders_overlap: Config error in {file}: the data folder ({data}) and the output folder ({output}) must be separate, neither inside the other, so exports never pick up logs.
errors.legacy_data: Found Phonarr data in the old location {old}, but the gateway now keeps its data in {new}. Change the volume line to mount the same host folder at {new} (e.g. ./phonarr:{new}) and start again. Nothing was changed.

arr.not_configured: {name} is not configured yet. Add it in Settings.
arr.profile_gone: Quality profile {profile} no longer exists in {name}.
arr.choose_profile: Choose a default {name} quality profile in Settings.
arr.root_not_configured: Root folder {root} is not configured in {name}.
arr.no_roots: {name} has no root folders. Add one in {name} → Settings → Media Management.
arr.choose_root: Choose a default {name} root folder in Settings.
arr.root_inaccessible: {name} reports the root folder {root} is not accessible. Check the volume mount and permissions in {name}.
arr.language_profile: Sonarr v3 needs a language profile; none found.
arr.tls: TLS handshake with {host} failed ({exc}). Check the scheme (http vs https) and that the certificate is valid for this hostname.
arr.dns_hint_tailscale: Tailscale MagicDNS names only resolve if the gateway container is on the tailnet (e.g. run it with a Tailscale sidecar or use the Docker service name instead).
arr.dns_hint_default: Check the hostname, or use the Docker service name (e.g. http://radarr:7878).
arr.refused: Could not connect to {host}. Is {name} running, is the port right, and is the gateway on the same Docker network?
arr.timeout: {name} did not respond in time at {url}.
arr.rejected_key: {name} rejected the API key. Copy it from {name} → Settings → General.
arr.redirect: {name} redirected to {location}. Check the URL base / scheme.
arr.no_api: No {name} API at {url}. If {name} uses a URL base (e.g. /{service}), include it.
arr.non_json: {url} answered, but not with the {name} API (got non-JSON). Check the URL base.
arr.wrong_app: That URL is {found}, not {expected}. Check the host and port.
arr.bad_url: Enter a full URL such as http://radarr:7878 (Docker service name) or http://192.168.1.10:7878.
arr.url_query: The base URL should not contain a query string or fragment.
arr.dns_hint_docker: That looks like a Docker service name. It only resolves while that container is running and on the same Docker network as the gateway. Check it's up (docker ps), and check `networks:` for the phonarr service (docker inspect {host_only} shows its networks).
arr.refused_localhost: Could not connect to {host}. Inside Docker, localhost means the Phonarr container itself, not {name}. Use the Docker service name (e.g. http://{name_lower}:{port}) or the server's LAN address.
arr.bad_lookup: {name} answered the search with something that isn't a list of results (it may be starting up). Try again in a moment.

log.no_token: No ARR_GATEWAY_TOKEN set. Generated one and saved it to {path}
log.dev_fake: DEV_FAKE_ARR=1: talking to a SIMULATED Radarr/Sonarr. Never use this in production.
log.no_web: No web frontend at {path}; serving the API only
log.batch: Batch request: {total} titles, {added} added, {existing} already there, {failed} failed
log.retried: Retried {media_type} {id}: cleared {cleared} failed queue item(s), search started
log.titles_unreadable: Could not read titles list {path}: {error}; keeping the previous list
log.titles_skipped: Skipping {media_type} list entry without a valid {field}: {item!r}
log.poller_failed: Poller cycle failed; trying again next cycle
log.startup: Phonarr {version} starting: data={data_dir} web={web} token={token_source} radarr={radarr} sonarr={sonarr} poller={poller} log_level={level} tz={tz}
log.env_ignored: {service} URL from the environment ({env}) differs from the saved connection; keeping the saved one. Change it in Settings, or remove the saved connection to re-seed from the environment.
log.add_landed: {service} didn't answer the add of {media_type} {id} ({error}), but the title is in its library now: linked it
log.missing_unconfirmed: {title} is missing from the {service} library ({count} of {needed} reads in a row); keeping its last status until confirmed
log.tvmaze_scanned: TVmaze: scanned {pages} pages ({shows} shows), kept the {kept} most popular with a TVDB ID
log.tvmaze_failed: TVmaze scan failed, trying again in {seconds} s: {error}
log.tvmaze_resolved: TVmaze: {ready} of {total} shows have Sonarr details ({looked_up} looked up now, {missing} unknown to Sonarr)
log.tvmaze_lookup_failed: TVmaze: Sonarr lookup for tvdb {tvdb} failed: {error}
log.radarr_discover_degraded: Radarr Discover with recommendations failed ({error}); using the lists without them plus the last recommendations

compat.server_error: The server answered with its own error (HTTP {status}), so fields couldn't be checked: {message}. This is usually not an API change; check System → Status in that app.

calendar.end_before_start: end must be on or after start.
calendar.too_long: The calendar shows at most {max} days at a time.
calendar.not_a_list: {name} answered the calendar call with something that isn't a list. Is it still starting up?
calendar.tz_fallback: Unknown timezone {tz!r} from the client; using UTC

datafiles.not_zip: {src} is not a Phonarr data export (not a zip file).
datafiles.no_manifest: {src} is not a Phonarr data export: it has no {manifest}.
datafiles.wrong_format: {src} is a "{found}" file, not a "{format}" export.
datafiles.too_new: {src} is export version {found}; this version of Phonarr reads up to version {version}. Update Phonarr first.
datafiles.unsafe_path: {src} contains an unsafe path "{path}" (absolute, ".." or outside the data folder). Nothing was imported.
datafiles.unlisted: {src} contains "{path}", which the manifest doesn't list. Nothing was imported.
datafiles.missing: {src} is missing "{path}", which the manifest lists. Nothing was imported.
datafiles.damaged: {src} is damaged: "{path}" doesn't match its checksum or size. Nothing was imported.
datafiles.not_empty: The data folder {data} already has data ({example}). Run again with --replace to replace it (stop the app first). Nothing was changed.
datafiles.usage_export: Write the whole data folder to one .zip (FILE, or - for stdout)
datafiles.usage_import: Replace the data folder with an export (FILE, or - for stdin)
datafiles.usage_replace: allow replacing a data folder that already has data
